d:
Kapra vyavsay ke mamle men gujrat ke surat ke bad agar bihar men kisi mandi ki sabse jyada charcha hoti hai, to vah nalanda jile ka sohasray bajar hai. apni sasti daron aur vishal thok karobar ki vajah se is mandi ko 'mini surat' ke nam se jana jata hai. aalam yah hai, ki yahan matr 25 se 50 rupae ki shuruaati kimat se lekar 30 hajar rupae tak ki mahangi sariyan uplabdh hain.
